Status Detail.value: Big Rivers told the Kentucky Public Service Commission on September 24, 2026 that it intends to apply to retire the Reid combustion turbine after a catastrophic failure. The unit has been unavailable since August 24, 2024. Case 2026-00291.
Status Detail.note: The notice of intent filed September 24, 2026 at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00291/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09242026042139/Notice_of_Intent_to_File_Application.pdf names the Robert A. Reid combustion turbine, about 65 MW net, in service since 1976, and says Big Rivers proposes to retire it because of the unit's catastrophic failure. Big Rivers' 2026 resource plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00268/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09292026115438/2026_IRP_Public_Redacted_and_Appendices.pdf says the unit has been unavailable since August 24, 2024 and that Big Rivers will ask the commission to approve retirement. The full application had not been posted on the commission's case page when I looked, so no retirement date is known yet.

Capacity (MW).note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx lists generator GEN2 at 98.8 MW, which rounds to the 99.0 MW GEM shows. Matching row: Plant 1383, generator GEN2, status OP, natural gas fired combustion turbine, nameplate 98.8 MW, operating March 1976, owner Big Rivers Electric Corp, Webster County. Generator 1 (coal steam, 96 MW, 1966) is on the Retired sheet with retirement September 2020.

Turbine/Engine Technology.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists generator GEN2 as a natural gas fired combustion turbine. Matching row: Plant 1383, generator GEN2, status OP, natural gas fired combustion turbine, nameplate 98.8 MW, operating March 1976, owner Big Rivers Electric Corp, Webster County. Generator 1 (coal steam, 96 MW, 1966) is on the Retired sheet with retirement September 2020.

units.notes: The unit has been out of service since August 2024 and Big Rivers plans to retire it. The retirement application is due by November 20, 2026 and is not yet posted, so no retirement date is known. The coordinates already in GEM match the EIA table and are marked exact, so they were left alone. The EIA monthly table has no operator column. No document supports the conversion label, the 2015 start year or Backup Power. Latest Activity does not apply to an operating unit.

Owner(s).note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx names Big Rivers Electric Corp as the entity for plant 1383. The commission notice at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00291/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09242026042139/Notice_of_Intent_to_File_Application.pdf is Big Rivers' own filing about this unit. No sale or pending transaction was found.

qa.question: Should Reid 1 still be marked operating when it has been out since August 2024?
qa.finding: Big Rivers' 2026 resource plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00268/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09292026115438/2026_IRP_Public_Redacted_and_Appendices.pdf says the Reid combustion turbine has been unavailable since a catastrophic failure on August 24, 2024. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx still lists it as operating. Big Rivers filed notice on September 24, 2026 that it will ask to retire the unit.
qa.recommendation: Leave the status as operating for now. Re-check when the commission rules on case 2026-00291 and move the unit to retired once a document gives the retirement date.
qa.note: The notice at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00291/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09242026042139/Notice_of_Intent_to_File_Application.pdf gives no retirement date. A second filing, the notice of election at https://psc.ky.gov/pscscf/2026%20cases/2026-00291//20260924_Big%20Rivers%20Electric%20Corporation%20Notice%20of%20Intent%20and%20Election.pdf, says Big Rivers will file the application no later than November 20, 2026. The case page https://psc.ky.gov/Case/ViewCaseFilings/2026-00291 listed no application on November 5, 2026. So I did not propose a planned retirement year. Neither the notice nor the 2026 resource plan states a year. No mothballed status was found in any document.

qa.question: Is Reid 1 timepoint 2 really a coal-to-gas conversion started in 2015?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx shows no gas generator 1. It shows the old coal unit 1, 96 MW, retired in September 2020, and a separate gas combustion turbine, generator GEN2, 98.8 MW, operating since March 1976. GEM's 99 MW gas unit matches GEN2.
qa.recommendation: Ask the person who marked it a conversion for their source. If none exists, treat this unit as the 1976 combustion turbine, clear the conversion label and the 2015 start year, and use GEN2 as the unit ID in Other IDs (unit).
qa.note: I found no document that states a gas conversion of Reid in 2015, so I could not fill Conversion/replacement Data Source, Backup Power Data Source or a start year source. The existing start year source is a news article about the implosion of idled units at Sebree. The county should also be filled as Webster, which the EIA table gives for plant 1383. County and the generator ID are values for a person to type into the web form.

qa.question: Is the Big Rivers 2026 plan silent on a retirement year for the Reid turbine?
qa.finding: The 2026 Big Rivers resource plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00268/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09292026115438/2026_IRP_Public_Redacted_and_Appendices.pdf says Big Rivers will request commission approval to retire the Reid combustion turbine, and gives no year.
qa.recommendation: Leave Planned retire blank. For the IRP Notes line, write that the 2026 plan seeks approval to retire the 65 MW Reid combustion turbine, out since August 2024, with no date given.
qa.note: Searched the plan text for Reid and found only the retirement request, the August 2024 outage and the fuel oil backup project at Green Station that offsets its capacity.

entities.lookup_result: Already the owner in GEM; no new entity named.
